title: Carly Rae Jepsen’s ‘Run Away With Me’ Gets a GTA VI Boost and Climbs UK Charts
excerpt: A GTA VI feature revives Jepsen’s 2015 hit, sending streams soaring and landing it at No. 28 in the UK Top 40.
body:
## A Surprise Soundtrack Moment
Fans have long argued that Carly Rae Jepsen’s true pop masterpiece isn’t the ubiquitous "Call Me Maybe" but the 2015 single "Run Away With Me." Though it originally peaked at number 58, the three‑minute burst of euphoria has been a live‑show staple for years. Last week the track slipped into Grand Theft Auto VI, underscoring a high‑life sequence where protagonists zip around jet skis and pop champagne from a yacht.

## Streams Explode, Charts React
The GTA VI placement sparked an overnight surge: daily streams jumped from roughly 20,000 to 281,000, and the song re‑entered the UK Top 40 at a fresh peak of No. 28. Jepsen, speaking from Los Angeles, called the turn‑around “wild” and praised the unexpected plot twist.

## A Long‑Awaited Vindication
While "Run Away With Me" never enjoyed mainstream radio dominance, it has become a cult favorite among pop aficionados. The track helped cement the reputation of Jepsen’s 2015 album E•MO•TION as a landmark record, despite its modest initial sales. This year the 41‑year‑old released the ambitious double album *Day & Night*, showcasing everything from folk‑pop to dancefloor experiments, and welcomed her first child, Ilya, with co‑writer Cole Marsden Greif‑Neill.

## Looking Back, Moving Forward
Jepsen reflects that the pressure of following "Call Me Maybe" led her to craft music that felt authentic rather than formulaic. The recent chart resurgence proves that a song can find new life years later, especially when it lands in a cultural touchstone like GTA VI. Fans and newcomers alike now have a fresh reason to discover the track that many have long considered her true pop anthem.

(Source: BBC News)
